_comment: Genre cards for long sets (--long). 2026-10-16, user-approved design:
stage = BPM zone (cut only between zones) / block = 3-4 tracks of one card (genre).
Track -> card: anime flag first, then canonical genre (genre_map.json), then sound group if genre field empty
(34% of library has empty genre; untagged_groups keeps them usable). Track matching no card = unused in long mode.
level = energy step 1 (calm) .. 5 (peak). Next block may rise at most 1 level -> no lowbeat -> EDM jump.
default_on = checked in palette by default. anime also follows context (nightclub = off).
Counts/BPM re-measured 2026-10-17 on the new rekordbox library (nightclub pool 3793, DB 4111 analysed):
jpop 176 / 127.0 / 0.53 | hard 65 / 150.0 / 0.57 | reggae 47 / 108.8 / 0.35 | no card 63 (unused in long set).
Energy medians did NOT move from the 2026-10-16 basis -> levels left untouched.
Re-measure rule (user decision 2026-10-17, TO_WIN id=18 Q4): when the library changes, update these numbers;
review a card's level ONLY IF its energy median moves >= 0.05, OR the ordering of cards by energy median flips.
Otherwise leave levels alone. Windows may do this without asking Mac. Labels are free to edit anytime.
jpop card = untagged sound group g8 (vocal four-on-floor). No J-pop genre tag exists in the library, and
measuring g8 on 2026-10-17 showed its content is WESTERN vocal four-on-floor (Major Lazer, Katy Perry,
PeeWee ft. Pitbull ...) plus the user's own tracks; Japanese pop is a small minority. Label says 洋楽中心
for that reason (user decision 2026-10-17: rename only - do not split, do not merge into pop).
bpm_range (optional): block BPM for card limited to this range. Lowbeat cards = [80, 112] so their few
four-on-floor tracks (latin house ~125, reggae ~126) cannot replace the lowbeat opening (observed 2026-10-16).

_comment: Block-order planner costs (lower = better). Plan = sequence of blocks; each block = card + size + BPM.
sizes: block length in tracks (DJ theory 3-4). 5 only used when needed to fill exact total.
mix_max: BPM change between blocks still mixed (no cut). Above -> cut. Must be <= weights.hard.bpm_tolerance.
level: |card level - target level from curve|. down: per level dropped (breather allowed, not free).
repeat: per earlier use of same card (variety). cut: per cut (zone change). drift_down: BPM lowered while mixing.
random: seed jitter for 'おまかせ' variety. min_tracks_factor: card needs >= factor x tracks it will use near block BPM.
_peak_comment: Keep rising to the end (2026-10-16, user-approved). Measured before: 2 h set reached top level at ~60%,
last ~45 min flat (energy 0.67 -> 0.71 between last two quarters).
peak_reserve: top level (5) reserved for last fraction of set. Level target reaches top-1 at that point.
peak_early: cost per top-level block starting before reserve (soft; user may still set it by hand).
peak_energy: track energy target inside top-level stretch (from -> to). Pre-peak target ends at peak_energy[0] - 0.05.
end_not_top: cost if last block is not top level (seed jitter alone made 2 h end on techno; observed).
energy_gap: cost per 1.0 of energy a card CANNOT supply at that slot (target - best mean it could reach).
Added 2026-10-17. Before it, feasibility only asked 'enough tracks near this BPM', ignoring energy:
techno has ~100 tracks at 127-131 but hardly any above 0.6, so a late techno block came out 0.10-0.21
below its neighbours - an audible slump just before the finale, in 17 of 45 measured candidates.
